cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've arranged my exhibition opening so you can come tonight. Tell the quiz team their captain is leaving early for his sister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need me through the first round. I can't just abandon them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep the welcome until after round one. I can manage that. Tell them family comes next.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come then, but I'll say I've got a headache. Less fuss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, no announcement. Tell just the teammate beside you that you're coming for me. I'll move my whole welcome for you; let me at least outrank a headache.

reason: Make the host visibly adjust her event timing and the size of B disclosure to secure a relationship-priority rearrangement rather than only attendance.
